profile.title: Computer Science Engineer | Embedded Systems, IoT & Robotics
profile.tagline: ECC @ IEEE SB CE Kallooppara · Computer Science Student at APJ Abdul Kalam Technological University
profile.bio: Enthusiastic and forward-thinking Computer Science student at College Of Engineering Kallooppara (APJ Abdul Kalam Technological University), with deep hands-on expertise in ESP32 Microcontrollers, Arduino IDE, embedded systems, and autonomous robotics. Proven track record in collaborative engineering through consecutive internships at EVOLVE ROBOTICS and Genzee Technologies, paired with proactive leadership as ECC at IEEE SB CE Kallooppara. Passionate about bridging hardware intelligence with scalable modern software solutions.

experiences.description: Executive Committee member leading technical communications, coordinating university workshops, technical symposiums, and engineering initiatives for the student branch community.
Conducted hands-on robotics engineering, sensor telemetry integration, and microcontroller firmware programming for autonomous robotic systems.
Developed embedded firmware and edge device prototypes utilizing ESP32 microcontrollers and Arduino IDE for connected IoT architectures.
Assisted in circuit design, hardware debugging, sensor interfacing (I2C/SPI), and testing industrial telemetry sensor prototypes.

education.degree: Bachelor of Technology, Computer Science and Engineering (KTU University)
education.details: Specialization in Computer Science & Engineering. Deep focus on Data Structures, Algorithms, Microprocessors, Embedded Firmware, and IoT Architectures.

projects.title: Line Following Robot + Obstacle Avoidance
projects.description: We built a line following robot combined with obstacle avoidance using ESP32 as the brain.
projects.long_description: By combining IR sensors for precise track tracing and an ultrasonic sensor for automated obstacle detection, we created a smart, responsive little navigation platform.
